title: Summit Elite Travel Benefits: How They Apply
content:
Each tier of the Crestline Summit Loyalty Program carries travel benefits that the other charters apply to the member's own tickets and credits: the tier's checked bags per direction, complimentary preferred seating where the tier includes it, complimentary extra-legroom seating where the tier includes it, a waived same-day change fee where the tier includes it, and waived credit extension, reinstatement and telephone redemption fees where the tier includes it.

**Date that decides.** A benefit follows the tier held on the date the fee would be charged:

| Charge | Tier taken from |
|---|---|
| Checked bag | The check-in date |
| Seat | The purchase date |
| Same-day change | The purchase date |
| Credit extension, reinstatement or telephone redemption fee | The date of the extension, reinstatement or redemption |

A tier change therefore applies to charges made from the day of the change onward and never refunds a fee charged before it.

**Who is covered.** The benefits cover the member only, never other passengers on the same reservation, and require the member's Summit number to be on the ticket.

**Status.** A membership in dormant or closed status carries no travel benefits.

**Hypothetical case.** A member reaches Summit Gold on 12 May and checks bags for a flight on 20 May; the bag allowance of Summit Gold applies at that check-in. A seat bought on 2 May, before the change, keeps the fee charged then.
